posts.text: Exa 3.0, Exa Lite, upgraded highlights, and our expanded index are available today through the API. Read more: https://exa.ai/blog/exa-3
Exa 3.0 highlights make agents more accurate on search tasks, using 95% fewer tokens than full text.
Exa 3.0 expands our index for AI assistants: 1.27B ecommerce listings, 211M+ businesses, real-time news, sports, weather and market data.
We're also launching Exa Lite, our new search type at $4/1k, built for cost-sensitive apps.
Exa 3.0's gains come from upgrades across our retrieval stack, including our largest embedding model and Dynamic Highlights.
Introducing Exa 3.0: our largest ever improvement to search quality. Exa is now #1 on every benchmark we tested, from public evals to verticals like coding and GTM intelligence.
We sat down with @3blue1brown to discuss our research vision of "Attention over all the world's information."
Even the top search agents set to the highest effort modes cannot find 1/3 of the verified information. (ATLAS thread)
ATLAS tasks require many sources to retrieve fresh or niche information. (ATLAS thread)
Around 500,000 B200 GPU-hours were used for making this. Plus tens of billions of new data records from special sources.
Exa just passed $100m in annualized revenue. We've grown almost exactly 10x per year for 3 years. We now handle 2 billion requests a month from 200k+ teams.
ATLAS is the hardest search eval in the world. We created hundreds of real-world valuable search tasks that frontier models score <50%.
